description: Save a view: a name plus a filter in the vocabulary of search_mentions (keywords or keyword kinds, platforms, status, relevant, sentiments, intents, languages, author tags, follower range, replies, link hosts, automated, free text), lists any-of, `not` lists none-of, every condition ANDed, plus anyOf for OR: groups of those conditions, at least one of which must hold. Nothing is materialized: the view selects whatever matches when it is read.

description.description: What the view is for, shown under its name.

filter.description: The filter; empty selects every mention.

anyOf.description: OR across groups: a mention passes when it meets every condition of at least one group (1 to 10 groups). The other conditions still apply to every mention: the whole filter is (other conditions) AND (group 1 OR group 2 ...). A group takes the conditions of a view filter (platforms, sentiments, intents, keywordKinds, the not lists ...), with no anyOf of its own.

items.description: A group of conditions, all of which must hold: the vocabulary of a view filter, without anyOf.

automated.description: true: only posts that read as machine-made; false: only the rest.

excludeAuthors.description: Never these authors: display names, handles or profile URLs.

groupIds.description: Only matches of keywords in any of these groups (grp_...).

intents.description: Only mentions carrying any of these intent or topic tags.

isReply.description: true: only replies and comments; false: only top-level posts.

keywordIds.description: Only matches of any of these keywords.

keywordKinds.description: Only matches of keywords of any of these kinds: brand, competitor, topic.

languages.description: Only posts in any of these languages (ISO 639-1).

linkHosts.description: Only posts linking to any of these hosts, the host itself or a subdomain of it.

maxFollowers.description: Only authors with at most this many followers; unknown reach never passes.

minBookmarks.description: Only posts with at least this many bookmarks (saves), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minConfidence.description: Only mentions whose classifier confidence is at least this.

minFollowers.description: Only authors with at least this many followers; unknown reach never passes.

minLikes.description: Only posts with at least this many likes (upvotes, reactions), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minQuotes.description: Only posts with at least this many quotes, as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minRelevance.description: Only mentions scored at least this.

minReplies.description: Only posts with at least this many replies (comments), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minReposts.description: Only posts with at least this many reposts (shares, retweets), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

minViews.description: Only posts with at least this many views (plays), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.

notGroupIds.description: Never matches of keywords in these groups.

notLanguages.description: Never posts in these languages; an unknown language still passes.

notLinkHosts.description: Never posts linking to these hosts.

items.description: Platform: bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto, reddit, x, youtube, news, linkedin, tiktok, instagram, appstore (App Store reviews), googleplay (Google Play reviews), trustpilot (Trustpilot reviews), googlemaps (Google reviews of a place).

notRatings.description: Never reviews with these star ratings; posts that are not reviews still pass.

notSentiments.description: Never these sentiments; an unscored mention still passes.

notTags.description: Never authors tagged with any of these.

platforms.description: Only posts from any of these platforms.
